title: The Insane Story Behind the Czinger 21C
description:
A Yale-educated former Goldman Sachs executive, his son who joined as the first hire, a concept car that raised money to buy metal printers, and a hypercar that debuted online because the auto show was cancelled. That is the story behind the Czinger 21C. It is not a simple one, and our sources disagree on several details. Here is what they actually say. Our sources are an interview-based article from CSQ in September twenty twenty-two, an engineering article from the American Society of Mechanical Engineers dated March twenty twenty-five, a Facfox history, GTPlanet's February twenty twenty preview, a Backfire News report from March twenty twenty-four, and Wikipedia. Where they conflict, we show both versions. Our own arithmetic is labelled.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.

- CSQ, How the Czingers, and Their 3D Printed Supercar, are Catalyzing a New Age of Product Development, Sep 2022: https://csq.com/2022/09/lukas-czinger-kevin-czinger-vehicles-supercar-divergent-3d-printing/
